chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Safwan, from Is'haq ibn Ammar, who said:

I said to Abu Ibrahim (peace be upon him), 'It has reached us from your father that if a man marries the woman during her waiting period, she does not become permissible for him ever.' He (peace be upon him) said: 'This is when he is knowledgeable. But if he is ignorant, he divorces her, and she observes her waiting period, then he marries her with a new marriage.'
ai.seo_question: What is the difference in ruling if a man marries a woman during her waiting period while knowledgeable versus ignorant?
ai.summary: This narration from *Al-Kafi* elucidates the distinction between *iddah* (waiting period) and *iddah al-talaq* (divorce waiting period), establishing that marrying a woman during her *iddah* from a prior marriage renders her permanently prohibited to him if the man is knowledgeable of the ruling. However, for the ignorant, the marriage is dissolved, and she must complete her *iddah* before a new contract can be validly concluded. This highlights the Shia jurisprudential principle that ignorance can mitigate the permanence of a legal impediment, allowing for remarriage after rectifying the procedural error.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Safwan, from Is’haq Bin Ammar who said,

‘I said to Abu Ibrahim<sup>asws</sup> (7<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>), ‘It has reached us from your<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> that the man, when he marries the woman during her waiting period, she would not be Permissible for him, ever’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘This is when he has knowing. So if he was ignorant, they would be separated, and she would observe her waiting period, then he would marry her with a new marriage’.
en.sarwar: 10. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Safwan from Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following: “

I once said to abu Ibrahim, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, ‘It is narrated to us from your father that if a man marries a woman during her waiting period she becomes unlawful for him forever.’ He (the Imam) said, ‘That is the case if he knows about it, but if he is ignorant he must separate from her and she must complete the waiting period then he can marry her anew.’”
